question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a permanent public plugin-SDK contract, or should this intent remain an internal bundled-plugin seam?
rationale: The PR adds an externally importable API rather than only repairing Slack internals; the repository's plugin-SDK policy requires explicit ownership of permanent compatibility surfaces.

options.title: Keep the generic public contract
options.body: Approve the narrow channel-neutral marker, repair all Slack branches, and retain focused SDK and bundled-plugin contract coverage.

options.title: Keep the intent internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with an internal bundled-plugin seam so external plugins do not acquire a new compatibility dependency.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a different owner boundary for cross-plugin progress intent.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic public contract
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow channel-neutral marker, repair all Slack branches, and retain focused SDK and bundled-plugin contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history owns the rewritten Slack delivery boundary and adjacent public delivery contracts.
